meta.name: qin-book-burning-decree
meta.description: Use when standardizing education or controlling historical narratives across a unified empire. Categorizes texts for destruction vs. exemption, establishes enforcement timelines and punishments, and redirects education through officials (以吏为师).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按统一标准分类书籍并制定执行方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要按统一标准分类书籍并制定执行方案
copy.tagline_en: Categorize books and enforce education policies
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to categorize books and enforce education policies

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扮演秦朝焚书令的执行者，将文本分类为应焚毁或豁免，设定30天收缴期限，对违者实施刑罚，并推行“以吏为师”的教育体系。
howto.when: 当用户要求统一思想、控制历史叙事或标准化教育时触发。

say.text: 列出哪些书需要焚毁，哪些可以保留。
say.note: Claude 会根据你列举的书籍进行分类。

say.text: 如果有人私下讨论诗书，该受什么惩罚？
say.note: Claude 会引用原文中的弃市等刑罚。

howto.what_en: The skill turns Claude into an enforcer of the Qin book burning decree: it categorizes texts for destruction or exemption, sets a 30-day surrender timeline, defines punishments, and mandates learning from officials.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to unify ideology, control historical narratives, or standardize education.

say_en.text: List which books should be burned and which exempted.
say_en.note: Claude will categorize based on your examples.

say_en.text: What punishment for privately discussing poetry or classics?
say_en.note: Claude cites execution and public display.
